python3 -c "
import re

# Test patterns for numbers with grouping characters
patterns = {
    'with_grouping': r'\d[\d,_]*',
    'strict': r'\d{1,3}(?:[,\d_]*\d)*',
}

test_strings = [
    '1234567.89',
    '1,234,567.89',
    '1_234_567.89',
    '1,234_567.89',
]

for name, pat in patterns.items():
    print(f'{name}:')
    for s in test_strings:
        m = re.match(pat + r'\.\d+', s)
        print(f'  {s!r} -> {m.group() if m else None}')
"
